import base64,zlib,json,pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,os,tempfile,sys
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110')
control=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110-control')
control.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy()
toolchain=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/.rustup/toolchains/1.95.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu')
env.update({'PATH':str(toolchain/'bin')+':'+env['PATH'],'RUSTC':str(toolchain/'bin/rustc'),'RUSTDOC':str(toolchain/'bin/rustdoc'),'CARGO_HOME':'/home/qq/.cargo','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(toolchain/'lib')})
with (control/'native-overlay-preflight.log').open('wb') as output:
 r=subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/project-preflight.sh'],cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
if r.returncode:
 print(json.dumps({'preflight_returncode':r.returncode,'applied':False}),flush=True);sys.exit(r.returncode)
entries=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
for entry in entries:
 p=repo/entry['path']
 actual=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else 'absent'
 if actual!=entry['expected_sha256']:
  raise RuntimeError('overlay lease mismatch: '+entry['path']+' actual='+actual)
for entry in entries:
 p=repo/entry['path'];p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 fd,temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=p.parent,prefix='.native-overlay-')
 with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as output:output.write(entry['content'])
 os.replace(temporary,p)
result={'preflight_returncode':0,'applied':True,'files':[{'path':e['path'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256((repo/e['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for e in entries]}
(control/'native-overlay-applied.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
